_comment: Easier: open the Ask panel in the web UI and set this up there — it lists the provider's real models so you don't have to know an id. Otherwise copy to ai.local.json (gitignored) and edit.
_quality_note: Pick the most capable model you'll pay for. ~10-50KB per question (statistics plus a selection of real messages), so the cost difference is a cent or two and the quality difference is the whole feature.
model: <run Load models in the UI, or GET /v1/models>
